answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed for proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake agents costs real capital instead of a whisper of effort. Honest agents slowly climb a reputation ridge as they complete verified work, while fresh identities start in a dune of low trust and low limits. An attacker must fund each fake and risk losing its stake, which makes mass fakery unprofitable.
